note: Centers and diameters are round published basin scales used as the footprint of the thin-shell load. They are not a gravity inversion. Stress magnitudes are sliders, not these fields. Mascon flags follow the qualitative pattern in Neumann et al. (2004, Science 304, 842, doi:10.1126/science.1099208): Isidis and Utopia carry positive anomalies; Hellas and Argyre are the comparison basins without that flag.
